name: look_at_screen
description: Look at the user's screen right now and describe it, read the text on it, or answer a question about what is on it (an error message, a page, a document, what they are working on).

question.description: what the user wants to know about the screen, e.g. 'what does this error say'; leave empty for a general description

not_for: websites the user did not open
